title: Add modular assay training and exact/sampled peptide availability experiments
body:
The previous affinity fit produced nearly constant outputs, while mixed supervision left training support unclear. This PR adds a directly supervised modular model, explicit source/measurement contracts and enforced training-support checks, plus experimental exact and sampled peptide-availability models. It remains a draft: the full qualified biological model described in #130 and #132 has not been delivered.

### Implemented architecture

- Shared sequence representations, direct affinity/stability heads, whole-peptide class I and explicit sliding class-II registers with flanks.
- Optional MHC/TCR species and other annotation heads, pairing targets and independent peptide-source auxiliaries. Supplied annotations and overrides remain visible. Single grooves/chains can train applicable annotation tasks; unavailable pair outputs are masked. Auxiliary transfer and the default replay coefficient remain unvalidated.
- Cellular APC species, cell type, concurrent machinery-component states and cytokine exposure, with optional dose/duration and sourced priors. Defaults remain assumptions; sample annotations/overrides take precedence. Purified binding is separate from APC state.
- Separate digestion and shared MS-response features; binary and declared quantitative/censored bulk/elution observations. Compatible domains share readouts; incompatible scales stay separate. Paired full-TCR scoring conditions on the receptor before register pooling.
- Raw physical targets, exact/censored losses, training-only scalers, subset allocation, compatible checkpoint transfer and task removal/extension. Inference rejects unsupported parameters/features/states; coverage fails on exposed but untrained features. Exact resume restores optimizer/RNG/sampler/selection/coverage under pinned contracts; fresh-process CPU equivalence is verified, GPU/MPS bitwise equivalence is not.
- Original-measurement deduplication, conflicting-copy deferral, retained independent replicates and row-level dispositions. The Weirdo/reference and Hitlist IC50 cohorts preserve source identities, exclusions and partition limitations.

### Demonstrated model behavior

| Registered experiment | Result | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| 32-observation IC50 memorization | Training RMSE 0.03294 log10(nM) after 100 updates; all allocated features covered | Capacity control, not generalization or a diagnosis of the historical collapse |
| 7,000-label peptide-source auxiliary | Beats prevalence; composition has lower test cross-entropy | Prespecified comparison screen failed; no affinity-transfer claim |
| Local full-cohort IC50, one epoch | Test RMSE 1.1613 versus ridge 1.2291; Spearman 0.5117 versus 0.4306; AUROC 0.7371 versus 0.7067 | One seed/epoch, historically inspected held-outs, unresolved specimen/study independence |

The local fit uses all 21,636 admitted exact training measurements, supplied molecular species/class, peptide and two MHC groove sequences, and the canonical IC50 trainer. All 32 allocated tensors receive updates. Predictions vary, but their test SD is 0.695 versus target SD 1.342; class-II binder recall is only 0.088 and none of 203 test bounds is satisfied. Other holistic branches are disabled for this diagnostic. CPU took 169.97 s including evaluation; the small batch-64 benchmark favored CPU over MPS by about 14%, without establishing a general hardware ranking. [Full metrics, predictions and independent replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/e80fd42/experiments/2026-10-22_1745_codex_local-ic50-feasibility/README.md).

### Peptide-availability experiments and data

Registered synthetic experiments compare exact enumeration, REINFORCE, clipping/group-standardization factors, sample reuse, reference KL, partial observations, multiset objectives and a hybrid. These are computational/objective experiments, not biological concentration validation. Reports and frozen artifacts are in `experiments/experiment_log.md` and linked from #132.

The variable-length policy supports short/nonbinding products using a distribution over start and conditional length. Exact enumeration is the reference; lazy sampling scores conditional lengths only at sampled starts. On a 2,240-residue protein, lazy 64-draw forward/backward takes 3.36 ms versus dense 17.31 ms. All paired draws agree; independent NumPy replay verifies probabilities and gradients. This fixed-weight benchmark has zero optimizer updates, and the primitive is not yet integrated into the mixed-assay trainer. [Computation report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/80d5f9c/experiments/2026-10-22_1938_codex_variable-span-computation/README.md).

Biological inputs use the shared Hitlist curation system. PXD057588 macrophage elution/global-proteomics and PXD009092 proteasome-associated MAPP fragments have source and sequence-admission audits. The MAPP adapter/reference implementation is upstream in [Hitlist draft PR758](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/758). Its new 120-file generation independently verifies all 37,721 occurrences and preserves all original quantities byte-for-byte. Candidate origins do not duplicate labels. [Shared reference report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/5deda4f/experiments/2026-10-22_2251_codex_shared-mapp-references/README.md). That report established source preparation. The biological comparison below now uses the shared recipe.


The first biological availability comparison now trains on 616 MAPP peptides / 101 full parents through [Hitlist recipePR760](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/760). Nine local fits take 54.98 s total: exact/context test KL 0.3039, REINFORCE64/context 0.3119, context-free 0.3079 versus uniform 0.2890. None improves test composition RMSE either. Validation selects epochs 2–3; final training KL reaches 0.0227–0.0304 while validation worsens. This is a generalization failure for the observed captured-intensity task, not a failure to make training updates or proof of concentration prediction. Independent NumPy replay verifies all 11,088 prediction values, metrics, coverage and checkpoint selection. All six tensors change, but 704 individual parameters remain without nonzero gradients; condition-change predictions at selected checkpoints are nearly flat. [Full report, frozen cohorts, checkpoints and prediction dumps](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/dccafe1/experiments/2026-10-22_2330_codex_mapp-biological-comparison/README.md).

The subsequent [run-repeatability and 30-fit comparison](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/c06fcb7/experiments/2026-10-23_0037_codex_mapp-run-repeatability/README.md) uses a new shared complete-run recipe and unchanged original fitting cohort. Baseline composition repeats (Pearson 0.914), but run-to-run treatment change is weak (0.172). Fifteen exact and fifteen REINFORCE fits train all allocated parameters in 25.81 s. The validation-selected exact interaction model has development-test KL 0.2908 / RMSE 0.3241 versus uniform 0.2890 / 0.3213; no model beats uniform. Explicit interactions produce larger treatment changes but worse errors. Independent source, feature, gradient, checkpoint and metric replay passes, including all 10,080 prediction values. All artifacts are archived and hash-verified.

Uniform remains the development reference. The historical test has been observed; no fresh blind qualification is claimed. Normalizing by parent removes true processing-yield changes as well as precursor scale. Next data needs are [independent peptide MS-response calibration](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/762), [controlled inhibitor/reporter panels](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/759), and [precursor/specimen links](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/757). Shared MAPP recipes now use the canonical Hitlist 2.0 EvidenceStore/materialization interface in draft PR760; reviewed release remains pending.

### Validation and remaining scope

The earlier modular application snapshot `2214086` passed 2,547 tests with four skips; subsequent targeted changes have their own recorded checks, including 35 training/resume checks for the constant-correlation fix and 14 availability-policy tests. Those historical totals are not a claim about the current full tree. Current-head Presto CI is authoritative. Local pinned Ruff and strict MkDocs pass. The upstream reference implementation passes 3,236 normal Hitlist tests, 21 focused tests and independent complete-reference/source replay; its final-head Python matrix and indexed-corpus CI now pass. The initial recipes passed 3,243 normal local tests. The complete-run extension passes 20 focused tests and strict docs; its normal full-suite attempts were memory-preflight refused. Hitlist code commit b94289d passes all Python 3.10–3.14 unit CI (3.11: 3,247 passed, two optional skips), 96 indexed-corpus integration tests, coverage, lint and docs. A later task-notes-only commit has separate checks.

Remaining work includes qualified auxiliary/paired-TCR cohorts, full local affinity convergence/replication and censoring, controlled auxiliary transfer, APC contrasts, direct processing/transport supervision, MS anchors/transfer, source/specimen independence and serving/promotion qualification. TCRvdb author access remains pending. Hitlist 2.0 query/materialization merged in pirl-unc/hitlist#761 and closed its #739; the pinned MAPP source and recipes are now conserved through the canonical interface in draft PR760; independent precursor estimates and parallel-proteome pairing are in pirl-unc/hitlist#757. Captured fragments and MHC elution do not directly label free intracellular concentrations; precursor abundance, capture/detectability, yield and clearance remain distinct. PTMs and short/noncanonical class-II cores are unsupported.

Current requirements/evidence remain in `tasks/modular_model/completion-spec.md`, `completion-progress.md`, the canonical experiment log and #132. The default model and legacy checkpoint format remain unchanged.


### Canonical Hitlist integration and current CI repair

[Source/API/recipe conservation report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/7020b62/experiments/2026-10-23_0149_codex_mapp-v2-integration/README.md) independently verifies the schema-8 successor of the current Hitlist2.0 reference package: 124 predecessor files, 33 MAPP files, 18 typed relations / 1,829,008 queried rows, all three unchanged recipe targets/splits and 3,058 recomputed target values. Full portable recipe outputs and exact source/invocation/hash receipts are committed. No new fit or improvement in biological accuracy is implied.

Presto c06fcb7 CI exposed retired Hitlist top-level v1 imports. Explicit imports from retained historical source modules repair frozen-receipt/v4 parity audits without restoring aliases or downgrading. All 159 affected regression tests pass against actual Hitlist2.0; Ruff and strict docs pass. New MAPP uses EvidenceStore. This bounded archival repair is not a claim that every legacy trainer has migrated. Current-head hosted CI is authoritative; the full availability/concentration goal remains open.


### Known-load MS-response source audit

[Registered PXD004886 audit](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/3f1ae1b/experiments/2026-10-23_0216_codex_ms-calibration-admission/README.md) verifies all four originals and12,941 source cells. It identifies31 reporter forms/30 sequences, ambiguous design-versus-plot amounts,26 normalized-only response cells and missing acquisition identities. No fit or source correction was made. [Hitlist762](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/762) now owns the exact shared admission contract; the raw S4 endpoint and ambiguous full curves stay separate. This is an observation-model data advance, not a concentration predictor or an explanation of the earlier MAPP failure.

Full Presto CI passes at7020b62 (both lint/test/distribution jobs and both docs jobs); Hitlist6e275fe passes every Python matrix/integration/coverage/lint/docs check. The new source-audit-only commit3f1ae1b has its own pending CI. The normal local Hitlist test runner still refused at0.65GiB available/2.5GiB required, before launching workers; no local integrated full-suite pass is claimed.


### Shared MS calibration source audit

[Complete registered report and frozen artifacts](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/50dbfad/experiments/2026-10-23_0316_codex_shared-ms-calibration/README.md) verify all13,561 original source cells,6,138 S4 slots,3,410 curve positions,520 protocol parameters,157 prior files and allthree MAPP recipe contents. The failed first import is retained; distinct SMD2 aggregation identities are preserved. Shared source implementation is draft pirl-unc/hitlist#767, stacked on#760; #762 owns remaining molecular-form, sample/selection and calibration limits. [Next-stage specification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/50dbfad/experiments/agents/codex/plans/raw-s4-nominal-response.md) admits a bounded raw-S4 recipe before local response fitting. No new predictive outcome or intracellular concentration claim. Format/lint56 focused tests and strict docs pass; the normal full local Hitlist runner refused0.65/2.5GiB before pytest, without bypass.


### Local conditional MS-response outcome

[Complete registered report, checkpoints and predictions](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/9f8e4e0/experiments/2026-10-23_0359_codex_raw-s4-response/README.md) adds a source-qualified observation-component diagnostic. Shared Hitlist#767 recipe admits1974 raw positives into224 summaries for22 peptides, retaining all3069 raw-slot dispositions and protocol/form provenance. All295 fits,12,544 validation and672 outer-test predictions independently replay. Equal-peptide RMSE: mean1.1796,load/site**0.8084**,sequence-augmented1.2762. The sequence arm uses stronger shared regularization and also shrinks useful context coefficients; no universal absence-of-sequence-signal claim.

This is nested grouped diagnostic CV on a selected nominal-load panel, with no untouched external biological test or SWATH-to-MAPP transfer. It does not train the full Presto/availability architecture, resolve prior MAPP/IC50 failures or establish concentrations. Hitlist762 owns broader calibration/reconciliation; controlled-processing panels759 remain the next biological target. All62 artifact hashes and immutable report bytes verify; CSV compression preserves executed bytes.

### Controlled processing source audit (October 23)

[Verified source report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/dfe3af2/experiments/2026-10-23_0434_codex_mapp-controlled-admission/README.md): recovered PXD009508 epoxomicin/capture-control and PXD007263 time-course outputs; all146,832 peptide/run quantity comparisons independently replay. Source-name aliases, missingness, confidence and specimen/reference gaps remain explicit in [Hitlist759](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/759). Filed [Hitlist770](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/770) for quantitative purified-protein digestion time courses. This is source qualification, with shared admission and new biological fitting still pending; earlier predictive failures remain unresolved.

## Reviewed-evidence and source conservation — October 23, 2026

[Registered conservation report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/82feaf2/experiments/2026-10-23_0551_codex_adjudication-source-conservation/README.md); [Hitlist issue771](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/771).
The shared schema9 package now preserves all9 multimer reviews together with
MAPP and calibration data. Independent replay verifies183files,32queries and
allfour unchanged recipe outputs. Hitlist's normal local suite passes3,317tests;
the fix is pushed to draft767. No new biological fit: availability/precursor/MS
limits and the earlier MAPP uniform-baseline failure remain open. Next is shared
admission of the recovered cellular controls under Hitlist759.


## Completed controlled-response fit (2026-10-23)

[Full experiment, checkpoints and independent replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1110d49/experiments/2026-10-23_0721_codex_controlled-mapp-fit/README.md). The shared `mapp_controlled_complete_alpha6_response_v1` contrast at Hitlist0be964d preserves all prior run-export payloads and admits59/14/14 train/validation/test peptides. It requires three positive acquisitions in both untreated and epoxomicin arms and direct evidence in each arm; complete cases represent only2.56% of qualified training positives. All87 selected peptides and522 original run quantities independently replay.

Seven exact/REINFORCE32/128 fits, ridge and two controls completed locally. No fitted model beats the common-shift response control on both validation and test. Test log10 response RMSE: common shift0.63536, exact0.64789, sampled32mean0.64603, sampled128mean0.64421. Ridge0.62374 has worse validation error. All14,000 updates,28 checkpoints and870 predictions independently replay. Exact objective converges, yet training response RMSE worsens0.71048→0.81946 while reverse KL improves0.82458→0.53192. This identifies objective/measurement mismatch, not a requirement for more optimization or an established biological cause.

The cohort conditions on observed untreated quantities and both-arm detection; it does not measure intracellular concentration or unseen-product production. No model is promoted and no rescue tuning on the14 test peptides is planned. Known-substrate digestion time courses under #770 are the next source qualification. Missing specimen/precursor/capture-gene/selection metadata here remains unresolved. Source release reconciliation is separate from these immutable experimental inputs.


### Known-substrate kinetic source qualification

[Registered source audit](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0b92401/experiments/2026-10-23_0800_codex_digestion-source-audit/README.md); [Hitlist770](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/770). Recovered and verified all17 processed condition archives and exact substrate constructs, with545,664 raw peptide/run quantities. Independent H4 arithmetic matches27,432 raw quantities and13,284 final entries. RF1 has2,278 rows with contradictory time labels; forced zeros, censored values and repeated zero-time controls require explicit observation semantics. No kinetic model was fitted. Shared Hitlist source admission/reconciliation and a frozen observation objective precede the matched exact-cut/discrete-partition experiment.
